rule: Spec 050 §3.4 rule A and §3.14: a records-class span keeps exactly the keys whose registry placement names record, each value passing the key's check (capture_check for a reused key) under the Node's capture_labels and identity_mode; every other key, a failing value, a float, a map or bytes is dropped and counted (records_keys_dropped), never hashed or truncated. keys is the table (fabric/_records_keys_generated.py and fabricguard recordKeyValidators are generated from the same rows).

cases.name: every records key with a valid value
keys outside the table are dropped, never hashed
structured, float and receiver-owned values are dropped
clear source label and clear run id, pseudonymous Node
clear source label and clear run id, clear Node
generated run-id fallback embeds the s- source
exec.subprocess record keeps its process keys
process join keys only on exec.subprocess
exec.subprocess record keeps its namespace and created id
namespace and created id only on exec.subprocess
S-scoped keys on an agent record are dropped
method and status only on http.nonmodel

host_rule: Spec 053 §6.2.7 step 6 (spec 056 M2): a host group's fabricguard instance applies rule A, then keeps only the host placement (host_placement: the 053 §6.2.3 keys; the fabric.sensor.* rows and fabric.tenant_id are records keys only on a capture point of kind S). host_cases are read by fabricguard (TestRecordsSpanVectors); the SDK never emits a host record, and its rule A fails closed on a capture_point_kinds condition. Digest keys are admitted here; step 7 strips them without the group's permission.

host_cases.name: eBPF host record keeps its host keys
sandbox-scope record keeps its container and pod ids
agent keys on a host record are dropped
